title: StudyHub category registry
description: metadata/categories.json — the list of top-level categories the app shows. Adding a category = adding an entry here plus its catalog file.

groups.description: Optional. Library groups for the sidebar and dashboard (Foundation, Computer Science, …). A category joins one through its group field; categories without a known group are listed under Other subjects.

id.description: kebab-case identifier; also the folder name under content/.

icon.description: Relative path to a single-colour SVG icon under assets/icons/ (drawn in the current text colour as a mask), or null for the app default.

group.description: Optional. The id of an entry in the top-level groups array.

catalog.description: Relative path (from the repo root) to this category's topic catalog.

interactions.description: Optional. Relative path to this category's interaction registry (quizzes, visualizers, simulators attached to topics). Omit when the category has none.

subcategories.description: Optional grouping level. Empty array = topics sit directly under content/<category>/.

studyModes.description: Optional category-level study modes shown next to 'Learn' (which is always the topic list). Each mode combines several Markdown source files into one user-facing view.

sources.description: Markdown files shown as sections of this mode, in this order.

path.description: Relative path from the repo root. Lives in the category's reserved revision/ folder.

title.description: Section title shown in the app (tab/anchor label).
